name: 🕺 Catalog Emote Tester
desc:
✨ Catalog Emote Tester lets you try out a huge variety of emotes and animations for free! Discover different animation styles, test emotes in real time, and find the perfect ones for your avatar. 🕺

👆 Tap on players to sync with them!

✅ Any items or animations you purchase in-game will automatically be added to your Roblox inventory and can be used across all experiences.

NOTE👇
All in-game music is sourced from the official Roblox music catalog; we have no control over its content.

Game is inspired of: Catalog Avatar Creator

llm.loop: browse catalog emotes and animations -> try them on your avatar -> sync with other players -> buy items into inventory
llm.objectives: find and try emotes for your avatar
llm.instructions: try emotes free, tap players to sync, purchased items go to your Roblox inventory
llm.thumbnails: Hatsune Miku-style avatar dancing next to a wooden figure, emote picker UI with 'EMOTE!', avatar swap arrow
llm.complexity_notes: flat baseplate, catalog API browsing and emote playback
